posts.title: The House
posts.description: A cinematic exploration of architectural spaces, light, and shadow. This video piece captures the essence of domestic environments through careful composition and atmospheric visuals.
posts.author: multikunst

posts.title: Mask Sculpture
posts.description: An interactive 3D visualization of a sculptural mask form. Explore the intricate geometry through rotation and wireframe overlay, revealing the mathematical beauty hidden within organic shapes.
posts.author: multikunst

posts.title: Echo Chamber
posts.description: An interactive sound installation exploring the relationship between space, sound, and human presence. Visitors' movements trigger evolving soundscapes that blend ambient textures with generative compositions.
posts.author: Sofia Andersson

posts.title: Chromatic Drift
posts.description: A meditative video piece capturing the slow transformation of light through prismatic glass over the course of a single day. The work invites contemplation on the passage of time and the beauty of gradual change.
posts.author: Luna Park

posts.title: Neural Pathways
posts.description: A WebGL experience visualizing the firing patterns of neural networks. Users can interact with simulated synapses and watch emergent patterns form in real-time, exploring the beauty of computational neuroscience.
posts.author: Marcus Chen

posts.title: Field Recordings: Tokyo
posts.description: A sonic journey through Tokyo's diverse soundscapes, from the quiet meditation gardens of Meiji Shrine to the overwhelming energy of Shibuya crossing. An auditory exploration of urban Japan.
posts.author: Sofia Andersson

posts.title: Between Worlds
posts.description: A photo series documenting liminal spaces—airports, train stations, hotel lobbies—where people exist in transition, neither here nor there. These images capture the quiet poetry of in-between moments.
posts.author: Luna Park

posts.title: Data Portraits
posts.description: Personalized visualizations that transform individual social media data into unique abstract compositions, questioning digital identity and data ownership in the age of surveillance capitalism.
posts.author: Alex Rivera

posts.title: Kinetic Assembly
posts.description: A motion study exploring the choreography of industrial robots, finding unexpected beauty in the precise, repetitive movements of manufacturing automation. Art emerges from the mechanical.
posts.author: James Okonkwo

posts.title: Ephemeral Forms
posts.description: Documentation of large-scale environmental installations that exist only briefly before being reclaimed by nature. These works celebrate impermanence and the dialogue between human creation and natural forces.
posts.author: Yuki Tanaka
